video_title: The Man Phil Jackson Trusted With Michael Jordan & Kobe

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his role as a performance and mindfulness coach
quotes.excerpt: I help people be who they are. Basically, how to help people be with what is.
quotes.quote: People think of me as a mindfulness coach and a performance coach. I am a performance coach first, and mindfulness is the method. What I do is I help people be who they are. Basically, how to help people be with what is as it is and at the same time express themselves authentically. In other words, it is like being in the zone or being in flow, being able to go with things as they are and still be able to be who you are.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his first impression of Julius Erving at UMass
quotes.excerpt: I seen him play and learning how to play the game at a high level.
quotes.quote: We were roommates and we were playing. It was very interesting because my first interaction with him was before school started. We went over to the court and there was a dude over there. He had on street shoes and he was dunking on people. That was my first introduction to him as Dr. J. I seen him play and learning how to play the game at a high level, seen his evolution. He was like Michael Jordan before Michael Jordan because he had such a presence that we could not go anywhere on campus without drawing a crowd.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on Julius Erving's development as a player
quotes.excerpt: He was like Michael Jordan before Michael Jordan because he had such a presence.
quotes.quote: He was playing in a system, nothing ran for him, but when he went hardship, that is when things changed. He played his first semi-pro game. He was like Michael Jordan before Michael Jordan because he had such a presence. He was playing, he was just like an artist. He was doing stuff and I am saying, man, he is making that stuff up in real time. But that is what happens when you are in the flow, when you are in the zone. You have your basic fundamentals, but I felt like he could really express himself.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on overcoming addiction and connecting with Phil Jackson
quotes.excerpt: I had to learn how to deal with the chronic pain without drugs.
quotes.quote: I got injured and my career was over. I did not play anymore so I got addicted to pain meds. I was a functional substance abuser. I graduated from college and worked in corporate for a number of years. But at some point, being a heroin addict, you have to get high two, three times a day. Once I got clean, that is when I learned about mindfulness because I had chronic pain. I had to learn how to deal with the chronic pain without drugs. So that is when I got introduced to the mind-body process, the mind and the body are connected.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on how he began working with Phil Jackson
quotes.excerpt: Phil was talking to John and he said that he wanted somebody to come in.
quotes.quote: Phil was talking to John and he said that he wanted somebody to come in and help the guys deal with the stress of success because they had just won two NBA championships in a row. This was exactly 33 years ago. They came across me and they realized I was a room with Dr. J, so I had been around the league. I grew up like most other guys in the city. So I was invited to come to training camp in 1993. That began our more than 30-year relationship.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his coaching philosophy with Phil Jackson's teams
quotes.excerpt: I came in and I started talking about being a spiritual warrior and being in the zone.
quotes.quote: Phil wanted somebody else to come in that would not have the positional power like he had, but somebody to come in and teach the guys how to deal with the stress of success. So that was me. I came in and I started talking about being a spiritual warrior and being in the zone. People are all about the zone or being in flow, and so that is how I introduced it. You have to have a certain level of audacity to go and talk to a championship team that just won three in a row and think you can help them.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his immediate impact with the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: I had a lot of street cred, you know, room with Dr. J, come on, man.
quotes.quote: It was pretty much immediate. Because I had a lot of street cred, you know, room with Dr. J, come on, man. Being around him, I had the street cred and then I was able to deliver the goods and help them be able to play because one of the things that happened when I first got there was a crisis. I talked to them and I said, okay, there is two meanings of a crisis. One is danger and the other one is opportunity. So I said, we can sit here and let us focus on the opportunity.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his impact on Phil Jackson's leadership
quotes.excerpt: I saved his life by changing his leadership style.
quotes.quote: He was all about what I was doing and if you were to ask him, he will say that I saved his life by changing his leadership style. Because I talked to him about meeting them where they were and what I was doing was I could help him explain why he was doing things so he could take his game to another level, but also how important it was to have everybody else raise their game to the awareness. Because in the triangle system, it is a read, man. You have to be able to see things and respond.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on Michael Jordan's energy levels
quotes.excerpt: He has got too much energy. He is vibrating at a high level.
quotes.quote: He has got too much energy. He is vibrating at a high level, so he does not need that much sleep. That is what it is. When you are in the moment and when you are present and you are not wasting time on the negative thoughts and all of that energy, that you have access to a lot of energy and he had a lot of energy. That was just because he was vibrating at a different level.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on his first impression of Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: He is the closest thing to MJ in terms of his tenacity and his willingness to work.
quotes.quote: I met Kobe before I started working with the Lakers. My impression of Kobe was he is the closest thing to MJ in terms of his tenacity and his willingness to work and his desire to be the greatest.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on Kobe Bryant's memory and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He invited me to hang out with him for a week and I realized that he remembered everything.
quotes.quote: In 2015, he invited me to hang out with him for a week and I came and I talked to him and I realized that he remembered everything I taught him. I do not know if you remember, but after the game you came into the locker room with your two kids. I was with him. I was hanging out with him when you came in. We just vibe. We were a lot closer than most people know because you know, I work on the down low, you know. People do not know. I was the secret weapon for years because people do not want to know, they do not want to give up that they are doing this.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on the 'Mamba Mentality' and flow state
quotes.excerpt: You can go as high as 13 second winds and you can keep moving.
quotes.quote: It is what I would call my effort. It is this ability to generate enough energy to get beyond low energy. Enthusiasm is really important and persistence. This continuous application of energy. This balance, you know, not too high, too low, but it is just like slow is smooth and smooth is fast. Slow motion gets you there quicker. You never stop. You just keep going, keep going, keep going, keep going. You return, you begin again, begin again, begin again, begin again. And what happens is every creates energy. That is why MJ has so much because he pushes through. So we have this idea of a second wind, right? And people do not realize the second wind you push beyond that, you have another, but you can go as high as 13 second winds and you can keep moving. And this is not just me saying it. The psychologist William James said that years ago. He said that the energy is a man, he wrote a book about it, but you can keep moving. But the idea is you cannot entertain the negative energy zapping thoughts.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on the impact of social media on mental focus
quotes.excerpt: There is so many things to pull you off. People want your attention.
quotes.quote: It is way different now because there is so many things to pull you off. As a matter of fact, with this thing you get notifications and so you have to and everybody, that is the commodity, believe it or not, people want your attention. So they even consciously trying to get you to not be where you are. And they tell you, you know, it is better in the Bahamas or you go you need a break today, go to McDonald's. They programming you. So you have to be able to understand what you ingest and how you use your what you focus on.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on using meditation to control your mindset
quotes.excerpt: I got my mind on money, money on my mind. That is meditation.
quotes.quote: There is a couple of philosophers, Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg. They say I got my mind on money, money on my mind. That is meditation. You create what you hold in mind. So if you got garbage on your mind, that is what you are creating. If you got love on your mind, that is what you are creating. So this idea of taking the time and really monitoring what you ingest, not just food, but energy, all of that stuff. So you have to be conscious of being in the moment now. And that is what I teach, how to anchor yourself in the moment so you can make a choice based on what you want, not based on the pressure that you are getting and reacting to the pressure.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on Kobe Bryant's pre-game warm-up
quotes.excerpt: The best way to score is not to try to score.
quotes.quote: It was 2000 and this one I talk about all the time, but it is pre-game and I am watching them work out and whatnot. I have my session with the team before that. My thing is, you know how it is, everybody has their routine. I do not really like to mess with people when they are pre-gaming and whatnot, but I am observing Kobe doing warm-ups and dude is like, it is like two points is worth 35. He is just really trying hard. So I walked over to him and I said, hey Kobe, the best way to score is not to try to score. And he had 16 points in the first quarter.

quotes.speaker: George Mumford
quotes.summary_phrase: George Mumford on the importance of being present and relaxed
quotes.excerpt: If you do not have a goal and you just be open and let the game come.
quotes.quote: If you do not have a goal and you just be open and let the game come to you, just be present and then in the presence and just being alert and relaxed, then you are going to see way more opportunities. Which he did, he had 16 points in the first quarter without trying.
